pages.text: A main building — hatchery, command center or nexus — placed from a spawn egg founds your base: 50 minerals and 4 workers. One base per dimension, shared by all three races.
A map ringed with 8 armor shards of a race makes its supply platform. Fill it with ores, ingots, gems or vespene worth 500 minerals and use the command panel on it: a transport brings a worker.
